Featuring one riveting highlight per playoff-bound team from the regular season, this set showcases pivotal and intense plays as teams prepare to battle for postseason glory. From jaw-dropping apples to late game heroics, 'Playoff Bound' offers fans a thrilling glimpse into the moments that contributed to their favorite team propelling playoff contention.

description:
Beginning with a stretch pass from goaltender Juuse Saros, Tommy Novak receives the puck just before the offensive blueline and immediately heads toward the net. With a slick backhand-to-forehand move, he jukes the defender and then sends a wrister that finds the back of the net against the division-rival Colorado Avalanche.

description:
In the final two minutes of regulation, as the Oilers found themselves trailing 1-0, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins makes a tremendous defensive effort getting a stick on Danton Heinen’s shot attempt at the empty net just in time.  This game saving play allowed Leon Draisaitl to even up the score on the very next shift with only 80 seconds remaining in the third period.
